title: Master status shows the flow numbers read from /api/flow
description: After a merge, master status reads GET /api/flow with the master's coordinator credential and shows non-null flow numbers for 6 hours, 24 hours and 7 days with the merged attempt counted; /api/status carries no flow, and a failed flow read shows its reason while the rest of master status answers.

steps.name: after a merge, master status shows the flow with at least one attempt counted
